item.description: Razorpay test-mode integration. Without RAZORPAY_KEY_ID/RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET on the server, payment endpoints answer 503 PAYMENTS_DISABLED (accepted by these tests).

request.description: Creates (or returns the existing) Razorpay order for a pending internal order. The amount comes from the order, never from the request. Returns the public key id, razorpayOrderId, amount, currency and prefill data for Razorpay Checkout.

request.description: Request validation rejects anything that is not a 64-character hex signature.
With payments configured and a created Razorpay order this returns 400 INVALID_SIGNATURE; the order stays unpaid.

Verifies a Razorpay Checkout result on the server: HMAC-SHA256("<razorpayOrderId>|<razorpayPaymentId>", RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET) compared in constant time, then the payment is fetched from Razorpay to confirm order id, amount and currency (authorised payments are captured).

A successful verify needs a REAL razorpay_payment_id and razorpay_signature produced by a Razorpay **test-mode** checkout — complete checkout in the Vela frontend (or with Razorpay's test checkout as described at https://razorpay.com/docs/payments/payments/test-card-details/), copy the three values from the handler response into the collection variables razorpayPaymentId and razorpaySignature, then send this request. This collection never fabricates a payment success. The request is skipped while razorpayPaymentId is empty.
